tools.name: settings_search
tools.title: Search settings registry
tools.description: Search OrcaSlicer's settings registry by natural language or key substring (e.g. 'support interface distance', 'pressure advance'). Returns matching keys with scope and a one-line description. If you already know the exact key (e.g. 'layer_height', 'wall_loops'), skip this and call settings_get_values or settings_set_values directly; validation errors will catch mistakes.

scope.description: Restrict results to one preset scope. Omit to search all.

tools.name: settings_get_schema
tools.title: Get setting schemas
tools.description: Return the full schema for specific setting keys: type, unit, default, min/max or enum values with labels, which preset scope owns it, whether it can be overridden per-object/per-plate, and related keys (settings that interact with or are forced by this one). Use for unfamiliar keys before setting them; not needed for keys whose meaning and range you already know.

tools.name: settings_get_values
tools.title: Read effective setting values
tools.description: Return the effective value of settings and which layer produced each one. OrcaSlicer resolves settings through layers: preset -> project override -> plate -> object modifier. Each result includes {key, value, source, preset_name?} where source is one of 'preset', 'project', 'plate', 'object'. Omit 'keys' to list only settings currently modified from their preset value — the cheapest way to see what has been changed.

keys.description: Keys to read. Omit to return all settings modified from preset defaults.

plate_id.description: Resolve values as seen by this plate (1-based).

object_id.description: Resolve values as seen by this object, including its modifiers. Object ids come from project_inspect.

tools.name: settings_set_values
tools.title: Set setting values
tools.description: Set multiple settings in one call at an explicit layer. Values are validated against the registry before anything is applied; the call is transactional (all keys apply or none). The response lists 'applied' (key, old value, new value), 'side_effects' (other settings OrcaSlicer force-changed as a consequence, e.g. enabling spiral_mode alters wall and infill settings), and on failure 'errors' per docs/errors.md. Set dry_run=true to validate and preview side effects without changing anything. Changes affect the session project only; presets on disk are never modified.

settings.description: Map of setting key to new value, e.g. {"layer_height": 0.2, "wall_loops": 4, "sparse_infill_density": "15%"}.

scope.description: Which layer to write. 'project' overrides the preset for the whole project; 'plate'/'object' create narrower overrides and require plate_id/object_id.

dry_run.description: Validate and report side effects without applying.
